subject: [PATCH 35/60] mm/mempolicy: keep private nodes out of migrate_pages() destinations

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: No review comments or feedback have been provided by the community yet, so there is no summary to provide.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses issues in the Linux kernel's memory policy module, specifically related to private nodes and migration pages. The patch being analyzed (35/60) modifies the `migrate_pages()` function to exclude private nodes from its destination mask, preventing allocation failures when trying to migrate pages to these nodes.
